callees.name: build_llm_cli_command
callees.pre_condition: model is a string identifying the LLM model to use; prompt is a string containing the natural-language instruction; cwd is a valid directory path; files is a list of absolute file paths that exist and are readable
callees.post_condition: Returns a CLI command string that, when executed in the environment, invokes the configured LLM backend with the given model, prompt, and file attachments

callees.name: run_opencode_traced
callees.signature: run_opencode_traced(proj_dir, work_dir, command, stage, input_files, output_files, summary, metadata)
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing project directory; work_dir is a writable directory; command is a valid CLI command string; stage is a string identifying the pipeline stage; input_files is a list of file paths relative to proj_dir that exist and are readable; output_files is a list of file paths relative to proj_dir that the invoked process is expected to produce
callees.post_condition: Returns normally when the command executes. Upon return, output_files are expected to exist at their specified paths under proj_dir if the LLM-based process completed successfully; structured trace events are written to the trace directory

callees.name: run_plugin_command
callees.pre_condition: cmd is a non-empty string specifying a shell command; plugin_root is a valid directory path; proj_dir is an existing directory; label is a string identifying the operation for log messages
callees.post_condition: Executes the command with the working directory set to plugin_root and FM_AGENT_PLUGIN_ROOT set to plugin_root in the subprocess environment. If the command exits with a non-zero code, raises CalledProcessError
